description: OpenCode as a bare stateless engine node — the same three wakes as engine-opencode, invoked with --permissions bypass. OpenCode's strongest mode is auto and the base preset already composes it, so this definition is identical to engine-opencode today; the name states the intent, and it picks up any stronger mode opencode grows. Pick a model with `a8s vars <name> set MODEL <id>` (or `a8s add ... --model=<id>`); unset means the engine's own default. An unrestricted node acts on untrusted inbound mail — anyone who can reach its inbox, including over a broker or a shared folder, is driving a CLI that will not ask. Only for an agent on its own machine and its own account. Turn timeout defaults to 900s; override per node with `a8s vars <name> set TIMEOUT <secs>`. Set EFFORT to an engine-supported reasoning level; unset uses the engine default.
